purpose: Authorizes exactly three bounded, additive maintenance items identified by the read-only COMMERCIAL-V1-POST-INTEGRATION-MAINTENANCE-PREFLIGHT-R1 mission run against integration/commercial-v1 @ 94f0923c (PR #49 merge): (M1) canonical multi-grant support in the ODS scope/poststate CLI so a single invocation can authorize the union of multiple valid --protected-authority grants; (M2) a deterministic real-PostgreSQL regression guard proving the existing B0-17 PUBLIC EXECUTE invariant on the two governed 0060 functions is exercised by ordinary CI, not only by manual/certification paths; (M3) append-only post-merge closure evidence for PR #49 filling the acknowledged 'post_merge: {}' gap left open in COMMERCIAL_V1_WAVE2_RECONCILIATION_EVIDENCE_v1.0.1.json. M4 (hosted-b0-status refresh) and M5 (journal wrapper denominator redesign) are explicitly deferred and NOT authorized by this artifact.

m1_contract.defect: scripts/ods-scope.ts and scripts/ods-poststate.ts each treat --protected-authority as a scalar (last-write-wins); a repeated flag silently overwrites the previous value instead of accumulating, so one canonical invocation cannot authorize the union of two valid additive grants (proven necessary by the Wave2 reconciliation's two-run HPO-ODS-W2-08 + HPO-ODS-W2-09 workaround recorded in COMMERCIAL_V1_WAVE2_RECONCILIATION_EVIDENCE_v1.0.1.json gates.ODS_SCOPE).
m1_contract.required_semantics: protectedAuthorities: string[]; each --protected-authority <id> occurrence appends one id; resolve each id independently against the existing PROTECTED_GRANTS registry; union their exact path/pattern sets with de-duplication; any single unknown id fails the whole invocation closed; no wildcard broadening; --allow task-allowlist semantics remain fully independent and unweakened.
m1_contract.backward_compatibility: A single --protected-authority X invocation must remain byte/semantically identical to current behavior. No externally-visible JSON schema break for the single-grant case unless no compatible alternative exists — if one is required, treat it as an authority-delta trigger, not a default choice.
m1_contract.poststate_requirement: ods-poststate.ts does not import ods-scope.ts's resolution logic; it composes ods:scope as a subprocess step. Its own CLI parsing must independently accumulate --protected-authority the same way and forward every accumulated id to the ods:scope subprocess invocation it builds.

m2_contract.known_hazard: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION preserves an existing revoked ACL; DROP FUNCTION + CREATE FUNCTION resets to the PostgreSQL default (PUBLIC EXECUTE restored). The existing B0-17 check (db/hosted/baseline-postconditions.ts, COALESCE(p.proacl, acldefault('f', p.proowner)) against pg_proc/pg_namespace) already correctly detects this end-state, but today only runs via manual/certification paths (pnpm baseline:rehearsal:local, pnpm b0:status:*) that are not invoked by .github/workflows/ci.yml or .github/workflows/p1a-validation.yml. tests/hosted/checkpoint-b0.test.ts runs in CI but only exercises the check function against synthetic fixtures, never real pg_proc.
m2_contract.required_change: Add exactly one new test, tests/integration/function-execute-acl-guard.test.ts, placed so it is picked up by the real-Postgres path already provisioned by .github/workflows/p1a-validation.yml (tests/integration/** glob), applying the full migration chain against the ephemeral Postgres already started there and then reusing the existing exported B0-17 check/query logic (no duplication of the SQL invariant; no change to db/hosted/baseline-postconditions.ts).
preflight_required_before_writing: confirm tests/integration/** is included by the real-PostgreSQL integration test command
confirm p1a-validation.yml (or current equivalent) actually executes that command
confirm the workflow trigger covers the intended development/PR path
m2_contract.mutation_control: M2-N1 negative mutation and M2-P2 repair must be exercised only inside disposable/local PostgreSQL (never committed as broken SQL in the repository); if an exact DROP+CREATE cannot be performed safely due to trigger/dependency CASCADE constraints, the narrowest equivalent mutation that restores PUBLIC EXECUTE on the target function may be substituted, with the substitution and its equivalence to the DROP+CREATE end-state documented in the test file and the evidence artifact.

m3_contract.gap_closed: COMMERCIAL_V1_WAVE2_RECONCILIATION_EVIDENCE_v1.0.1.json records post_merge: {} and ODS_POSTSTATE: 'see post_merge (run after the merge commit)' — this artifact materializes that post-merge record using the M1 canonical multi-grant capability (HPO-ODS-W2-08 + HPO-ODS-W2-09 in one invocation), not the historical two-run workaround.
m3_contract.external_verification_policy: GitHub CLI/API read-only verification preferred where available; if Vercel read access is unavailable, record EXTERNAL_VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE rather than inventing preview/production facts.
